title: Two atomic nodes share the element id 'dup0001' (collides on .elementor-element-dup0001) → DUPLICATE_ELEMENT_ID
_comment: WP-Q01 INVALID fixture (one-per-failure-mode, Detailed-Req #4; 12-error-taxonomy.md §3.1 DUPLICATE_ELEMENT_ID). Two sibling atomic widgets both use id 'dup0001' — duplicate ids collide on the .elementor-element-<id> selector (R3; Elementor does NO server-side uniqueness check, so the agent must ids/remap). Each node is otherwise a valid typed-envelope tree ([R8]). VERIFIED valid:false {DUPLICATE_ELEMENT_ID} via Validator::dry_run on Elementor 4.1.1. prefilter.verdict:reject — R3 (id uniqueness across the tree) is one of the structural rules the TS pre-filter decides authoritatively, so it rejects; the F06 loader SKIPS the authoring-schema check for reject fixtures. meta-invariant reject⇒valid:false holds.
